{{Short description|Chinese-Canadian electrochemist (born 1956)}}
'''Jiujun Zhang''' ({{zh|c=张久俊}}; born August 1956) is a Chinese-born Canadian electrochemist and engineer.<ref name="FZU">{{cite web |title=张久俊 |url=https://www.fzu.edu.cn/xxgk/ysfc.htm |publisher=Fuzhou University |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref><ref name="RSC">{{cite web |title=Jiujun Zhang |url=https://rsc-src.ca/en/users/jiujun-zhang |publisher=Royal Society of Canada |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref> He is a professor and dean of the College of Materials Science and Engineering at [[Fuzhou University]].<ref name="FZU" />

Zhang was elected a Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Canada]]'s Academy of Science in 2017 and a Fellow of the [[International Society of Electrochemistry]].<ref name="RSC" /> He was elected a foreign member of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]] in 2023.<ref name="CAE2023">{{cite web |title=关于公布中国工程院2023年院士增选当选外籍院士名单的公告 |url=https://www.cae.cn/cae/html/main/col1/2023-11/23/20231123090056741245109_1.html |publisher=Chinese Academy of Engineering |date=23 November 2023 |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>

==Early life and education==

Zhang was born in August 1956 in [[Suzhou, Anhui]], China.<ref name="FZU"/> He entered [[Peking University]] in 1978, where he received a bachelor's degree in physical chemistry in 1982 and a master's degree in electrochemistry in 1985. He received a doctorate in electrochemistry from [[Wuhan University]] in 1988.<ref name="PKU">{{cite web |title=这些北大人，当选院士！ |url=https://www.pku.org.cn/info/1013/1152.htm |publisher=Peking University Alumni Association |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>

==Career==

Zhang worked at [[Huazhong Normal University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=WISE Public Lecture {{!}} Waterloo Institute Sustainable Energy {{!}} University of Waterloo |url=https://uwaterloo.ca/waterloo-institute-sustainable-energy/news/wise-public-lecture-96 |access-date=2026-09-16 |website=uwaterloo.ca |language=en}}</ref> From 1991 to 1996, he conducted postdoctoral research at the [[California Institute of Technology]], [[York University]], and the [[University of British Columbia]].<ref name="FZU"/><ref name="Nankai">{{cite web |title=张久俊博士学术报告 |url=https://chem.nankai.edu.cn/2014/0304/c24073a359177/page.htm |publisher=Nankai University |date=4 March 2014 |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>

Zhang  worked at [[Ballard Power Systems]], where his work included research on [[proton-exchange membrane fuel cell]]s and their catalysts.<ref name="FZU"/><ref name="SpringerBio">{{cite web |title=PEM Fuel Cell Electrocatalysts and Catalyst Layers: Fundamentals and Applications |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-1-84800-936-3 |publisher=Springer Nature |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref> He later joined the [[National Research Council Canada]], where he became a principal research officer.<ref name="FZU"/><ref name="EIC2016">{{cite web |title=EIC Fellow: Jiujun Zhang |url=https://eic-ici.ca/honours_award/cit16/Zhang.pdf |publisher=Engineering Institute of Canada |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>

From 2016 to 2021, Zhang worked at [[Shanghai University]], where he served as dean of the College of Sciences and dean of the Institute for Sustainable Energy.<ref name="FZU"/><ref name="IAOEES">{{cite web |title=Management Team |url=https://www.iaoees.org/management.php |publisher=International Academy of Electrochemical Energy Science |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>

In October 2021, Zhang joined [[Fuzhou University]] on a full-time basis. In December of that year, he was appointed dean of its College of Materials Science and Engineering and dean of the Institute for New Energy Materials and Engineering.<ref name="FZU"/><ref name="FZUCollege">{{cite web |title=张久俊 |url=https://cl.fzu.edu.cn/info/1179/16002.htm |publisher=College of Materials Science and Engineering, Fuzhou University |date=11 May 2022 |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>

==Research==

Zhang's research concerns electrochemical energy storage and conversion and related materials. His research areas include electrocatalysis, fuel cells, lithium and other batteries, metal–air batteries, supercapacitors, carbon dioxide electroreduction, and water electrolysis.<ref name="FZU" /><ref name="RSC"/><ref name="EnergyReview">{{cite journal |last1=Zhang |first1=Jiujun |title=A review of advanced electrocatalysts for polymer electrolyte membrane water electrolysis |journal=Electrochemical Energy Reviews |year=2026 |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S2589778026000059 |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>

His earlier work included the development and evaluation of electrocatalysts and catalyst layers for proton-exchange membrane fuel cells, including research into alternatives to platinum-based catalysts.<ref name="SpringerBio" /><ref name="EIC2016"/> His research has also included electrochemical sensors and other electrochemical devices.<ref name="RSC"/>

==Awards==

Zhang was elected a Fellow of the [[Engineering Institute of Canada]] in 2016.<ref name="EICFellows">{{cite web |title=EIC Fellows |url=https://eic-ici.ca/fellows/ |publisher=Engineering Institute of Canada |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref> He was elected a Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] in 2016 and a Fellow of the Academy of Science of the [[Royal Society of Canada]] in 2017.<ref name="RSC"/><ref name="IAOEESEarly">{{cite web |title=Achievements |url=https://www.iaoees.org/news/NewsletterIusse4.pdf |publisher=International Academy of Electrochemical Energy Science |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>

Zhang is a Fellow of the [[International Society of Electrochemistry]].<ref name="ISE">{{cite web |title=ISE Fellows |url=https://www.ise-online.org/ise-fellows/ |publisher=International Society of Electrochemistry |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>

In 2023, Zhang was elected a foreign member of the Chinese Academy of Engineering.<ref name="CAE2023"/> The academy's biographical listing also records his 2023 election.<ref name="CAEZhang">{{cite web |title=张久俊 |url=https://www.cae.cn/cae/html/main/colys/30544082.html |publisher=Chinese Academy of Engineering |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>

Zhang was a founder of the International Academy of Electrochemical Energy Science (IAOEES), established in 2013, and has served as its president.<ref name="IAOEES"/>
